answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh anchor. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra fable buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each reef has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 1n56q.
